overlay_rows.name: five-lane-cadence-guard
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Hold manual lane checks to the 15-minute x1 and 10-minute x2 marks while watchers supervise in the background.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Bind cadence gate output into every five-lane board.

overlay_rows.name: substantial-output-repair-classifier
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Separate substantial-but-unharvestable outputs from shallow or missing outputs.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Represent format gaps as repair_launched or repair_waiting instead of false failure.

overlay_rows.name: standalone-heading-contract
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Guarantee exact heading lines for CLI outputs so machine gates can count command, system, skill, and eureka sections.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Add heading proof to prompt dry-runs and repair prompts.

overlay_rows.name: watcher-telemetry-row-normalizer
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Normalize app and CLI watcher receipts into one safe lane-row schema.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Use the watcher telemetry draft as the schema seed.

overlay_rows.name: raw-boundary-firewall
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Prevent raw CLI output, app transport, screenshots, sessions, credentials, and local paths from entering published receipts.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Run raw/private/path scans before every curated commit.

overlay_rows.name: source-to-build-crosswalk
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Tie each x2 build choice to at least one current-source row and one Journey/Trinity reflection row.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Create build matrix rows with source_ref and reflection_ref fields.

overlay_rows.name: no-overclaim-claim-boundary
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Keep GMUT, physics, consciousness, empirical, and canon gates open unless exact evidence artifacts prove otherwise.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Carry claim_boundary into each report, board, and closeout synthesis.

overlay_rows.name: publication-provenance-receipt
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Hash curated subject files and record validation and remote-equals-local evidence.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Generate provenance receipts for x2 artifact packets.

overlay_rows.name: stale-flow-refresh-watch
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Recognize repeating blocker patterns without destructive repair or premature conclusion.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Classify Aster heading repair and any CLI final-message waits as stale-flow watch rows.

overlay_rows.name: command-surface-compatibility-map
overlay_rows.label: enabled-for-x2-design
overlay_rows.purpose: Track compatibility across launchers, notifiers, quality gates, source ledgers, provenance receipts, and closeout builders.
overlay_rows.x2_action: Create a v5 x2 command/helper compatibility map before phase advance.
